title: knowledge.component_retired.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the ComponentRetired event payload (KN-SCAN-4(b)): a recorded occurrence does NOT denote an additional component on this release and leaves the ACTIVE projection. The row stays stored on both sides — retirement is a projection change, never an erasure, so the audit trail keeps every occurrence Themis recorded and 'we retired this' stays distinguishable from 'this never happened'. It deliberately carries NO superseded-by pointer: the canonical row already exists independently and needs no relationship to a row that never denoted a distinct thing. The event asserts a STATE rather than a transition, so re-delivery re-asserts the same state and changes nothing. It never touches a Finding or a Position.

PURL.description: The exact row being retired — the one thing a consumer needs.

Reason.description: Operator-facing audit text, never a decision input; nothing branches on it. KN-SCAN-4(b) emits only `duplicate_identity`.
